name: Hacker News
description: Stories and comments from Hacker News, read from its public API. An example of an http adapter: no browser, no login, plain JSON over HTTPS.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.title: List stories
tools.description: The first stories on one of Hacker News's lists (top, new, best, ask, show or jobs): each one's title, link, author, points, comment count and time.

tools.name: get_story
tools.title: Get story
tools.description: One story or job by its id, with its text and up to 10 of its top-level comments as plain text.
